steps.command: cd /app && ls -la && echo "---ALICE---" && cat alice_calendar.ics && echo "---BOB---" && cat bob_calendar.ics && echo "---CAROL---" && cat carol_calendar.ics

cd /app && cat > meeting_scheduled.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Terminal-Bench//Scheduled Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:REQUEST
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-20240117@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240116T000000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol.
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:carol@example.com
LOCATION:Conference Room A
STATUS:CONFIRMED
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
# Ensure CRLF line endings without touching input files
sed -i 's/$/\r/' meeting_scheduled.ics
file meeting_scheduled.ics && cat -A meeting_scheduled.ics

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('meeting_scheduled.ics')
s = p.read_text()
if 'alice@example.com' not in s:
    s = s.replace(
        'ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;',
        'ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT;PARTSTAT=NEEDS-ACTION;RSVP=TRUE:mailto:alice@example.com\r\nATTENDEE;CN=Bob;'
    )
    p.write_text(s)
print(p.read_bytes().decode())
PY
ls -l /app/meeting_scheduled.ics

cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('meeting_scheduled.ics')
data = p.read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n').replace(b'\r', b'\n')
data = data.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')
p.write_bytes(data)
print(repr(data[:120]))
PY
# validate structure and confirm inputs unchanged
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for f in ['alice_calendar.ics','bob_calendar.ics','carol_calendar.ics','meeting_scheduled.ics']:
    b=Path('/app/'+f).read_bytes()
    print(f, len(b), b.count(b'BEGIN:VEVENT'), 'CRLF' if b.count(b'\r\n') else 'LF')
s=Path('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics').read_text()
print('starts', s.startswith('BEGIN:VCALENDAR'), 'ends', s.rstrip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR'))
print('attendees', all(x in s for x in ['alice@example.com','bob@example.com','carol@example.com']))
